title: Hummer: Towards Limited Competitive Preference Dataset
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical challenge of reducing competition between alignment objectives (such as accuracy, empathy, and harmlessness) in LLM preference datasets. It introduces the ADC and ADC-B metrics to measure these conflicts. While it measures 'harmlessness' and 'empathy', it treats them as technical alignment dimensions rather than as a study or benchmark of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
